verdict.rationale: Reflect explicitly supports a custom URI scheme (reflect://reflect?command=...) for deep linking into actions like appending to daily notes, plus a documented API with OAuth2/PKCE for building external clients that append data and read bookmarks — directly enabling scripting/workflow integration. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the API or deep links in practice, and no OpenAPI spec/discoverable schema (probes returned 404s) to fully validate robustness.
